_comment: Signed announcements envelope v1 (GET /v1/announcements). A NEW envelope beside the notices one on purpose: notice verification rebuilds the canonical preimage from the client's own struct, so a field a deployed client does not know makes every notice fail verification and that client shows nothing at all. Every value here is synthetic.

announcements.headline: Warren production is open
announcements.body: Your beta account gets one free month on production.

announcements.headline: Scheduled maintenance
announcements.body: The API is unavailable tonight between 02:00 and 03:00 UTC.
